sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 30000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 30000
Only [Arcana Wings] Tokana can be used as Unlocking Potential material
